product.title: Two Phase Make-up Remover
product.description:
Two Phase Make-Up Remover is designed to effectively and gently remove all eye and lip make-up even waterproof and longlasting make-up, without leaving an oily feeling. It removes make-up without the need for rubbing, and the eyelids and eyelashes feel soft, smooth and supple through the moisturising agents. The formula is enriched with a special complimentary component which is known to protect and to help improve eyelash resistance towards falling out during make up removal. No Parfum & Parabens added.

HOW TO USE: Shake well before each use to mix the two phases. Place a cotton pad soaked with product on each closed eye and lips separately. Tap the pads on eyelid and lips gently for 10-15 secs, then wipe off without rubbing.

CAUTION: For external use only. Do not contact with eyes. Do not take into the mouth. If this happens, rinse well with plenty of water.
